leads.actionReason: Publishes a generic email and phone; dedicated bakery-ingredients distributor with no visible cream/chocolate supplier. Ask who supplies whipping cream today.
leads.evidence: Own site: "Your Trusted Baking & Food Ingredients Partner"; sells bakery flavours, colours, Muzuri icing sugar, preservatives, skimmed milk powder, ice-cream powders. No whipping-cream or chocolate brand listed. No public evidence of an exclusive arrangement found.
leads.fit: Whipping cream powder, fillings, glazes, cake mixes, compound chocolate — fills gaps in a range that today is flavours, colours, icing sugar, milk powder and ice-cream powders.

leads.actionReason: Strong cold-chain distributor to bakeries/foodservice with published email. Pitch ranges Rich's doesn't cover.
leads.evidence: Homepage lists Rich's Bettercrème among brands; imports Emborg, Kellogg's; Volza shows ~30 whipped-cream import shipments 2023–2025. LOCK-IN FLAG: distributes Rich's (bigger competitor) — do not lead with whipping cream.
leads.fit: Fillings, glazes, waffle/crepe sauces, spreads, ice-cream toppings; whipping cream only as second-line/price option.

leads.actionReason: Published sales email; large local bakery that also sells bakery inputs.
leads.evidence: Own site: bread, cakes, pastries plus flour, margarine and bakers' fat. Makes its own fats — do not pitch fats. No public tie to a competitor found.
leads.fit: Cake mixes, fruit/bake-stable fillings, glazes, whipping cream for cakes; possibly redistribution to small bakers.

leads.actionReason: No contact on an own website found; phone appears only in the KCCA city directory. Call the head office / approach procurement via LinkedIn company page.
leads.evidence: Multi-outlet chain in Uganda and Nairobi (8 outlets in 2018, likely more now); listed by Export Genius as a direct importer of cooking cream. No public tie to a competitor found.
leads.fit: Whipping cream (liquid/powder), waffle/crepe sauces, chocolate sauces, fillings for desserts.

leads.actionReason: No official website or published contact found; reach via outlet visit, the Egyptian commercial office in Kampala, or trade fair.
leads.evidence: Monitor (2014): 12 outlets, 30,000+ loaves/day, cakes, cookies, pastries. Data old; no public tie to a competitor found.
leads.fit: Cake mixes, fillings, glazes, whipping cream.

leads.actionReason: No own-site contact; phone only in KCCA directory. Visit Namuwongo branch.
leads.evidence: KCCA directory: sourdough, European pastries, croissants; wholesale and retail. Supplies bread to Café Javas. Possible common ownership with Hot Loaf (Monitor 2015) — unverified.
leads.fit: Fillings, glazes, compound/couverture chocolate, whipping cream.
leads.type: Artisan bakery-café chain with wholesale supply

leads.actionReason: No published contact available; use website/LinkedIn company page once site is back, or meet at Agri Food Uganda.
leads.evidence: Launched Riham confectionery line (~2022). Website under maintenance at research time. No public tie to a competitor found.
leads.fit: Compound chocolate, cream and fruit fillings for biscuits/confectionery (industrial packs).

leads.actionReason: No official website/contact found; approach via Egyptian commercial office or trade fair.
leads.evidence: URA Taxman profile: makes biscuits, confectionery, juices and sauces; Euromonitor names Britania among Uganda snacks players. No public tie to a competitor found.

leads.fit: Retail packs: spreads, cake mixes, jelly/powder desserts, whipping cream powder sachets; possibly private label.
